title: Cluster marker-matched statement ranges before long-method extraction
wanted_capability: analysis.methodRegions, given a marker (statementContains) on a long Java method, groups nearby matching statements into contiguous candidate clusters and reports per cluster its line range, statement count, live-out count, capture shape, extractability stop reasons, and whether it exercises a requested construct (for example a multi-live-out result-record extraction), ranked so the intended target is not displaced by the easiest single-live-out block.
missing_primitive: Marker-match cluster ranking for analysis.methodRegions on long methods
fallback_used: The probe manually inspected scattered marker matches and drifted to the easiest single-live-out block instead of the intended multi-live-out construct target.
evidence: crates/bbox-refactor/src/java/method_regions.rs: matching_statement_nodes filters statements by substring and limit_statement_nodes truncates in source order; no grouping or ranking
crates/bbox-refactor/src/java/method_regions.rs: JavaMethodRegionExtractability (live_out_count, stop_reasons) is computed per statement or requested range only
notes: Generic finding from a private Java probe. The existing compact marker search reduced output size, but did not rank candidate clusters by the construct under test, so the agent selected a valid but irrelevant easier extraction.
resolution_note: Obsolete after PR #133 (https://github.com/daystrom-institute/blackbox/pull/133), merged and deployed at 237007630ef5700a610550e0d3dabc610ad6f550. The custom bro-harness, isolate, LSP/refactor runtime and their tool surfaces were removed. The affected custom-runtime capability is retired; this is not a claim that the requested feature was implemented in native providers.
